prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. CACE school material N4: SUBJECT + ACTION + OBJECT. Create ONE synthetic photorealistic educational studio photograph with natural anatomy and textures of adult cook in plain chef hat and apron cutting tomato, visibly separating a piece with appropriate tool; paper uses scissors, food uses ordinary utensil, no injuries. Exact Catalan target: CUINER + TALLAR + TOMÀQUET. The subject must visibly perform the action ON the specified object; make both recognizable. Ordinary realistic action, no fantasy anatomy. Human subject skin tone: light. People wear everyday sweaters and trousers.  Pure white seamless background, minimal essential supporting props only. Add second living character ONLY when the target object is that character, or essential to show a human body part; no bystanders. All relevant figures and objects fully inside frame with generous margins, entire composition centered occupying at most 70 percent of frame. Correct hands/paws and plausible physical contact. Friendly and suitable for primary school. Absolutely NO text, letters, numerals, logos, signatures, speech bubbles, music notes or watermark, including books, money and clothing. Single scene, not collage.
review: Cuiner amb gorra i davantal tallant un tomàquet a rodanxes sobre taula; mans coherents.
